signature.name: VTask.updateFinset
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {π : ι → Sort u_2} -> [DecidableEq ι] -> (x : (i : ι) → π i) -> (s : Finset ι) -> (y : (i : ↥s) → π ↑i) -> (i : ι) -> π i

conventions.statement: When the query index `i` belongs to the finite set `s`, the result is the replacement value `y ⟨i, hi⟩` from the overriding function `y`.
When the query index `i` does not belong to `s`, the result is the background value `x i` from the original function.

facts.statement: example : let s : Finset (Fin 3) := {0, 2}; let x : Fin 3 → ℕ := fun _ => 0; let y : (i : ↥s) → ℕ := fun i => if (i : Fin 3) = 0 then 10 else 30; VTask.updateFinset x s y 1 = 0 := by decide
